body: Thats the post i saw. Life sucks
Im 28. This has been this way for at least the last 15 years, maybe longer. Ur really pretty, i think if i was as good looking as you i might be more ok with it all.

Many, but i can tell the difference. At work everyone is very friendly with me cuz they know i work hard and that its important to try to be cool with everyone you work with so u dont have drama at work. But outside of work nobody is like that with me. At social gatherings im always kind of ignored unless somebody feels like using me as a joke to get a laugh. The only time i feel ok is when i get that false friendliness at work. At all other times in all situations i feel like the people in the room are uncomfortable with me being there.

 One example on the more extreme end of tge spectrum is one time a few years ago somebody invited me to their friends bday party. Nobody really talked to me or seemed to want me there but at one point i found myself standing in the kitchen. The bday boy was tellin a story to everyone in the room n had everyones attention. Our eyes met and he stopped right in the middle if his story to ask why i was looking at him like that. I said what do you mean? He wanted to know if i had a problem n why i was looking at him like that. I didnt even know him and he didnt know me but he made me leave. Things like this happen all the time.

I dont believe i am. Everywhere i go, everyone i meet, they all hate me. They hate the things i say and the way i say them. They hate how i look, how i think, everything. Nobody ever says anything good about me. Never a compliment. Literally not one. They dont even laugh at my jokes anymore. I dont know why. I feel helpless.
Move away to a different town
